decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting faces long procurement cycles, so two years reveal little about its value, and keeping a niche specialist line listed costs little.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still has visibility and fits the ergonomic workplace direction, and nothing in its results yet shows its value cannot be realized, so the option stays open cheaply.
As a flagship microprismatic pendant aligned with the firm's efficient, glare-free strategy, it warrants continued commitment rather than abandonment.

Dropping the sibling HMI searchlight concentrated the marine searchlight option on this line, and with uncertainty unresolved in a slow-moving specialist market, its low holding cost justifies keeping it.
